name: Kartboard Dash
description:
About This Game

Kartboard Dash is a fast-paced arcade kart racer where everything-tracks, karts, and the entire world-is built from cardboard, tape, and pure imagination.

Race through handcrafted tracks packed with sharp turns, ramps, obstacles, and surprises. The world may look playful, but the racing is intense, chaotic, and highly competitive. Quick reactions, smart powerup usage, and adapting to constant changes are the keys to victory.

📦 Built From Cardboard

Enter a unique DIY world where every track, prop, and kart feels handcrafted.
From taped edges to layered textures, each environment brings a playful yet detailed racing experience.

⚡ Chaotic Powerups

Pick up powerups during races to gain the edge—or cause chaos.
Boost ahead, slow rivals, or disrupt the track at just the right moment to turn the race in your favor.

🔄 The race changes every lap. Literally.

In the final two laps, random modifiers activate for ALL players — speed surges, bumper madness, hazard trails. You can master the track. You can never master what happens next.

Expect:

  • Sudden speed boosts

  • Bumper-style collisions

  • Hazard trails behind karts

  • Unexpected chaos that forces instant adaptation

No two races ever play the same.

🎭 Unique Characters & Karts

Choose from a growing roster of racers and karts, each bringing their own personality to the track.
Mix and match to find your perfect racing style.

🎲 Unpredictable Races

Between dynamic powerups, evolving modifiers, and creative track design, every race feels fresh, chaotic, and exciting.

🏎️ Fast, Accessible Arcade Racing

Easy to pick up, hard to master.
Whether you're drifting through corners or battling for first place, the action never slows down.

🚀 About the Game

Kartboard Dash is designed to deliver fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable races.
You’re not just racing the track—you’re reacting to everything happening around you.

Every lap brings new surprises. Every race tells a different story.

📅 Coming Soon

Beta playable build releasing soon.
Wishlist now and be among the first to jump into the chaos!
short_desc: Your friends are the obstacle. The cardboard is the track. The chaos is the point. Kartboard Dash is an arcade racer where every lap escalates, every race feels different, and no two finishes match. Easy to start, hard to quit, built on cardboard, tape, and wild decisions.
